title: Publish repeatable container images from fixed inputs
goal: Control timestamps, base-image identity and build inputs when repeated container publishes need comparable image digests.

selectionNotes: GA SDK11.0.100 produced two local x64/Arm64 OCI archives with fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and pinned runtime index; all file entries and content-addressed blobs match after clean. Archive output does not exercise Docker/Podman loading, image execution or registry pushes.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Canonical managed application target; no container runtime execution is claimed.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: SDK11 supplies container publishing and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH; exact measured archive-output conditions are separate evidence.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Intended language mode of the original managed consumer; the XML glob configuration itself is language-neutral.

packageAssets: SDK-provided Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers tasks; a compatible, digest-pinned runtime base image index must be supplied.
platforms: A host supported by SDK 11 and the selected engine; example image targets linux-x64 and linux-arm64.
prerequisites: Supply a real compatible pinned runtime image index and the fixed source-snapshot epoch.
Use ContainerArchiveOutputPath for engine-independent archive output. Local engine loading is a separate path requiring the selected engine.
constraints: Pin a base image index covering both requested architectures; a mutable tag is insufficient.
NuGet package timestamp reproducibility is a separate claim.
Target 11 only; .NET 10 sources are previous-release comparisons, not an additional historical foundation or a tested older-target route.
Playbook only serves embedded guidance. No provisioning, registry push, telemetry transmission or consumer mutation is performed by consulting it.
stabilityLimitations: GA SDK11.0.100 produced two local x64/Arm64 OCI archives with fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and pinned runtime index; all file entries and content-addressed blobs match after clean. Archive output does not exercise Docker/Podman loading, image execution or registry pushes.

evidence.scope: Official-source review and original sample authoring only. SDK/target/language values describe intended inputs, not observed compilation. No compilation, cross-compilation, mock, execution, artifact or installed MCP proof.
